description: Register a new remote MCP, A2A, or x402 endpoint or refresh its public Assay Observatory dossier by running a live HTTP, agent-card, and JSON-RPC tools/list inspection without policy gating. Target must be a public HTTPS origin (private IPs are rejected with a 400 error); each call appends a timestamped observation and increments rug_pulls if tools_hash drifted since the prior stored observation. Writes to the public ledger; first 5 calls/IP are free and retries are idempotent on steady schemas. Use to onboard or re-index a server; for pre-call allow/deny gating use assay_preflight; for historical observations or hash pinning use assay_get_ledger_policy; for post-payment disputes use assay_verify_delivery. Example: target='https://agentdiet-72343955726.us-central1.run.app/mcp'.

target.description: Public HTTPS URL of the remote MCP server, A2A agent, or x402 endpoint to inspect (e.g. 'https://tandem.ac/mcp'). Private and loopback IPs are blocked.

name: assay_probe
title: Register & Refresh Endpoint Conformance Telemetry
